verdict.rationale: Bitwarden describes itself as an open source password manager, its first-party MCP server repo is GPL-3.0, and community reports confirm it relicensed back to a Free/Open license after the SDK controversy and has open-sourced transparently. That controversy was resolved, so it does not contradict the claim. missing for 10: first-party documentation naming the licenses of the core client and server repositories, and direct links to the main source repositories beyond the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The most trusted open source password manager for passwords, passkeys, and secrets
First-party repo (bitwarden/mcp-server, GPL-3.0), published to npm.
Thank you to Bitwarden for relicensing back to Free/Open License
